typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EffDate as timestamp,
		ReconRecordMatch as string,
		ReconIdentifiedBreaks as string,
		PortName as string,
		sm_id as integer,
		HoldID as integer,
		Currency as string,
		{MT CurrFxRate} as decimal(18,10),
		{MT MV} as decimal(24,8),
		{CDBO MV} as decimal(28,10),
		{MV Diff} as decimal(29,10),
		{AbsMV Diff} as decimal(29,10),
		{MT CompanyAU} as string,
		{CDBO CompanyAU} as string,
		{MT AssetClass} as string,
		{CDBO AssetClass} as string,
		{MT ProductCategory} as string,
		{CDBO ProductCategory} as string,
		{MT SubProductCategory} as string,
		{CDBO SubProductCategory} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ToAddLoaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MV_Diff as integer,
		MT_ProductCategory as string,
		MT_MV as integer,
		MT_AssetClass as string,
		sm_id as integer,
		CDBO_ProductCategory as string,
		CDBO_SubProductCategory as string,
		CDBO_MV as integer,
		EffDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PortName as string,
		MT_CurrFxRate as integer,
		ReconIdentifiedBreaks as string,
		MT_CompanyAU as string,
		HoldID as integer,
		AbsMV_Diff as integer,
		MT_SubProductCategory as string,
		CDBO_CompanyAU as string,
		Currency as string,
		Loaddate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CDBO_AssetClass as string,
		ReconRecordMatch as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MV_Diff = {MV Diff},
		MT_ProductCategory = {MT ProductCategory},
		MT_MV = {MT MV},
		MT_AssetClass = {MT AssetClass},
		sm_id,
		CDBO_ProductCategory = {CDBO ProductCategory},
		CDBO_SubProductCategory = {CDBO SubProductCategory},
		CDBO_MV = {CDBO MV},
		EffDate,
		PortName,
		MT_CurrFxRate = {MT CurrFxRate},
		ReconIdentifiedBreaks,
		MT_CompanyAU = {MT CompanyAU},
		HoldID,
		AbsMV_Diff = {AbsMV Diff},
		MT_SubProductCategory = {MT SubProductCategory},
		CDBO_CompanyAU = {CDBO CompanyAU},
		Currency,
		Loaddate = ToAddLoaddate,
		CDBO_AssetClass = {CDBO AssetClass},
		ReconRecordMatch),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
